text: {"label":"Behavioral Interpretation of Language and Grammar","definition":"Conceptual and interpretive analyses of language as verbal behavior: grammar, translation, rhetoric, verbal correspondence, terminology, and how verbal operants such as echoics and tacts organize everyday and technical language.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Interprets natural language phenomena conceptually, unlike neighbours on foreign-language acquisition, broad overviews of verbal behavior research, or experimental analyses of intraverbal stimulus control."}
